(*
========================================================================================================================
 SECTION 2: 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR) SENSOR VOTING SUITE
 Mathematical Implementation:
   - Median selection with persistent deviation monitoring.
   - Fault detection, isolation, and latching for individual channels.
   - Graceful fallback: 2oo3 (3 healthy) -> 1oo2 (2 healthy) -> 1oo1 (1 healthy degraded) -> Trip.
========================================================================================================================
*)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 2.1 FLIGHT MACH NUMBER VOTER                                                                  *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Compute pairwise deviations *)
IF ABS(rMach_Flight_ChA - rMach_Flight_ChB) > rTol_Mach THEN
    iMach_DevCount_AB := iMach_DevCount_AB + 1;
ELSE
    IF iMach_DevCount_AB > 0 THEN iMach_DevCount_AB := iMach_DevCount_AB - 1; END_IF;
END_IF;

IF ABS(rMach_Flight_ChB - rMach_Flight_ChC) > rTol_Mach THEN
    iMach_DevCount_BC := iMach_DevCount_BC + 1;
ELSE
    IF iMach_DevCount_BC > 0 THEN iMach_DevCount_BC := iMach_DevCount_BC - 1; END_IF;
END_IF;

IF ABS(rMach_Flight_ChC - rMach_Flight_ChA) > rTol_Mach THEN
    iMach_DevCount_CA := iMach_DevCount_CA + 1;
ELSE
    IF iMach_DevCount_CA > 0 THEN iMach_DevCount_CA := iMach_DevCount_CA - 1; END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Latch isolated channel faults if persistence threshold exceeded *)
IF (iMach_DevCount_AB > iMaxDiscrepancyCycles) AND (iMach_DevCount_CA > iMaxDiscrepancyCycles) THEN
    bMach_ChA_LatchedFault := TRUE;
END_IF;
IF (iMach_DevCount_AB > iMaxDiscrepancyCycles) AND (iMach_DevCount_BC > iMaxDiscrepancyCycles) THEN
    bMach_ChB_LatchedFault := TRUE;
END_IF;
IF (iMach_DevCount_BC > iMaxDiscrepancyCycles) AND (iMach_DevCount_CA > iMaxDiscrepancyCycles) THEN
    bMach_ChC_LatchedFault := TRUE;
END_IF;

bMach_ChA_Valid := NOT bMach_ChA_LatchedFault AND (rMach_Flight_ChA >= 0.0) AND (rMach_Flight_ChA <= 12.0);
bMach_ChB_Valid := NOT bMach_ChB_LatchedFault AND (rMach_Flight_ChB >= 0.0) AND (rMach_Flight_ChB <= 12.0);
bMach_ChC_Valid := NOT bMach_ChC_LatchedFault AND (rMach_Flight_ChC >= 0.0) AND (rMach_Flight_ChC <= 12.0);

(* Voted Mach computation *)
IF bMach_ChA_Valid AND bMach_ChB_Valid AND bMach_ChC_Valid THEN
    (* Full 2oo3 Median Selection *)
    IF ((rMach_Flight_ChA >= rMach_Flight_ChB) AND (rMach_Flight_ChA <= rMach_Flight_ChC)) OR
       ((rMach_Flight_ChA <= rMach_Flight_ChB) AND (rMach_Flight_ChA >= rMach_Flight_ChC)) THEN
        rVoted_Mach := rMach_Flight_ChA;
    ELSIF ((rMach_Flight_ChB >= rMach_Flight_ChA) AND (rMach_Flight_ChB <= rMach_Flight_ChC)) OR
          ((rMach_Flight_ChB <= rMach_Flight_ChA) AND (rMach_Flight_ChB >= rMach_Flight_ChC)) THEN
        rVoted_Mach := rMach_Flight_ChB;
    ELSE
        rVoted_Mach := rMach_Flight_ChC;
    END_IF;
ELSIF bMach_ChA_Valid AND bMach_ChB_Valid THEN
    rVoted_Mach := (rMach_Flight_ChA + rMach_Flight_ChB) * 0.5;
ELSIF bMach_ChB_Valid AND bMach_ChC_Valid THEN
    rVoted_Mach := (rMach_Flight_ChB + rMach_Flight_ChC) * 0.5;
ELSIF bMach_ChA_Valid AND bMach_ChC_Valid THEN
    rVoted_Mach := (rMach_Flight_ChA + rMach_Flight_ChC) * 0.5;
ELSIF bMach_ChA_Valid THEN
    rVoted_Mach := rMach_Flight_ChA;
ELSIF bMach_ChB_Valid THEN
    rVoted_Mach := rMach_Flight_ChB;
ELSIF bMach_ChC_Valid THEN
    rVoted_Mach := rMach_Flight_ChC;
ELSE
    rVoted_Mach := 0.0;
    wAlarmWord_Critical.1 := TRUE; (* Triple Mach Sensor Loss *)
END_IF;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 2.2 MICRO-PERFORATED SKIN DYNAMIC DIFFERENTIAL PRESSURE VOTER                                *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF ABS(rDeltaP_Skin_ChA_mbar - rDeltaP_Skin_ChB_mbar) > rTol_DeltaP_mbar THEN

ELSE

END_IF;

IF ABS(rDeltaP_Skin_ChB_mbar - rDeltaP_Skin_ChC_mbar) > rTol_DeltaP_mbar THEN

ELSE

END_IF;
IF (iDeltaP_DevCount_AB > iMaxDiscrepancyCycles) AND (iDeltaP_DevCount_BC > iMaxDiscrepancyCycles) THEN
    bDeltaP_ChB_LatchedFault := TRUE;
END_IF;
IF (iDeltaP_DevCount_BC > iMaxDiscrepancyCycles) AND (iDeltaP_DevCount_CA > iMaxDiscrepancyCycles) THEN
    bDeltaP_ChC_LatchedFault := TRUE;
END_IF;

bDeltaP_ChA_Valid := NOT bDeltaP_ChA_LatchedFault AND (rDeltaP_Skin_ChA_mbar >= -10.0) AND (rDeltaP_Skin_ChA_mbar <= 250.0);
bDeltaP_ChB_Valid := NOT bDeltaP_ChB_LatchedFault AND (rDeltaP_Skin_ChB_mbar >= -10.0) AND (rDeltaP_Skin_ChB_mbar <= 250.0);
bDeltaP_ChC_Valid := NOT bDeltaP_ChC_LatchedFault AND (rDeltaP_Skin_ChC_mbar >= -10.0) AND (rDeltaP_Skin_ChC_mbar <= 250.0);

IF bDeltaP_ChA_Valid AND bDeltaP_ChB_Valid AND bDeltaP_ChC_Valid THEN
    IF ((rDeltaP_Skin_ChA_mbar >= rDeltaP_Skin_ChB_mbar) AND (rDeltaP_Skin_ChA_mbar <= rDeltaP_Skin_ChC_mbar)) OR
       ((rDeltaP_Skin_ChA_mbar <= rDeltaP_Skin_ChB_mbar) AND (rDeltaP_Skin_ChA_mbar >= rDeltaP_Skin_ChC_mbar)) THEN
        rVoted_DeltaP_Skin_mbar := rDeltaP_Skin_ChA_mbar;
    ELSIF ((rDeltaP_Skin_ChB_mbar >= rDeltaP_Skin_ChA_mbar) AND (rDeltaP_Skin_ChB_mbar <= rDeltaP_Skin_ChC_mbar)) OR
          ((rDeltaP_Skin_ChB_mbar <= rDeltaP_Skin_ChA_mbar) AND (rDeltaP_Skin_ChB_mbar >= rDeltaP_Skin_ChC_mbar)) THEN
        rVoted_DeltaP_Skin_mbar := rDeltaP_Skin_ChB_mbar;
    ELSE
        rVoted_DeltaP_Skin_mbar := rDeltaP_Skin_ChC_mbar;
    END_IF;
ELSIF bDeltaP_ChA_Valid AND bDeltaP_ChB_Valid THEN
    rVoted_DeltaP_Skin_mbar := (rDeltaP_Skin_ChA_mbar + rDeltaP_Skin_ChB_mbar) * 0.5;
ELSIF bDeltaP_ChB_Valid AND bDeltaP_ChC_Valid THEN
    rVoted_DeltaP_Skin_mbar := (rDeltaP_Skin_ChB_mbar + rDeltaP_Skin_ChC_mbar) * 0.5;
ELSIF bDeltaP_ChA_Valid AND bDeltaP_ChC_Valid THEN
    rVoted_DeltaP_Skin_mbar := (rDeltaP_Skin_ChA_mbar + rDeltaP_Skin_ChC_mbar) * 0.5;
ELSIF bDeltaP_ChA_Valid THEN
    rVoted_DeltaP_Skin_mbar := rDeltaP_Skin_ChA_mbar;
ELSIF bDeltaP_ChB_Valid THEN
    rVoted_DeltaP_Skin_mbar := rDeltaP_Skin_ChB_mbar;
ELSIF bDeltaP_ChC_Valid THEN
    rVoted_DeltaP_Skin_mbar := rDeltaP_Skin_ChC_mbar;
ELSE
    rVoted_DeltaP_Skin_mbar := 0.0;
    wAlarmWord_Critical.2 := TRUE; (* Triple DeltaP Sensor Loss *)

    bSWBLI_ChC_LatchedFault := TRUE;

       ((rSWBLI_RMS_ChA_kPa <= rSWBLI_RMS_ChB_kPa) AND (rSWBLI_RMS_ChA_kPa >= rSWBLI_RMS_ChC_kPa)) THEN
        rVoted_SWBLI_RMS_kPa := rSWBLI_RMS_ChA_kPa;
    ELSIF ((rSWBLI_RMS_ChB_kPa >= rSWBLI_RMS_ChA_kPa) AND (rSWBLI_RMS_ChB_kPa <= rSWBLI_RMS_ChC_kPa)) OR
          ((rSWBLI_RMS_ChB_kPa <= rSWBLI_RMS_ChA_kPa) AND (rSWBLI_RMS_ChB_kPa >= rSWBLI_RMS_ChC_kPa)) THEN

ELSIF bSWBLI_ChB_Valid AND bSWBLI_ChC_Valid THEN
    rVoted_SWBLI_RMS_kPa := (rSWBLI_RMS_ChB_kPa + rSWBLI_RMS_ChC_kPa) * 0.5;

    rVoted_SWBLI_RMS_kPa := (rSWBLI_RMS_ChA_kPa + rSWBLI_RMS_ChC_kPa) * 0.5;
ELSIF bSWBLI_ChA_Valid THEN

ELSIF bSWBLI_ChB_Valid THEN

ELSIF bSWBLI_ChC_Valid THEN

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 2.4 DISTRIBUTED TURBOCOMPRESSOR SPOOL SPEED VOTER                                            *)

IF ABS(rSpoolSpeed_TC1_rpm - rSpoolSpeed_TC2_rpm) > rTol_Spool_rpm THEN

    IF iSpool_DevCount_AB > 0 THEN iSpool_DevCount_AB := iSpool_DevCount_AB - 1; END_IF;

    IF iSpool_DevCount_BC > 0 THEN iSpool_DevCount_BC := iSpool_DevCount_BC - 1; END_IF;

IF ABS(rSpoolSpeed_TC3_rpm - rSpoolSpeed_TC1_rpm) > rTol_Spool_rpm THEN

    bSpool_ChA_LatchedFault := TRUE;
END_IF;

bSpool_ChA_Valid := NOT bSpool_ChA_LatchedFault AND (rSpoolSpeed_TC1_rpm >= 0.0) AND (rSpoolSpeed_TC1_rpm <= 110000.0);

bSpool_ChC_Valid := NOT bSpool_ChC_LatchedFault AND (rSpoolSpeed_TC3_rpm >= 0.0) AND (rSpoolSpeed_TC3_rpm <= 110000.0);

    IF ((rSpoolSpeed_TC1_rpm >= rSpoolSpeed_TC2_rpm) AND (rSpoolSpeed_TC1_rpm <= rSpoolSpeed_TC3_rpm)) OR

wVotingStatusWord.4 := bDeltaP_ChB_Valid;

wVotingStatusWord.7 := bSWBLI_ChB_Valid;
wVotingStatusWord.8 := bSWBLI_ChC_Valid;

(*
========================================================================================================================
 SECTION 3: AEROTHERMODYNAMIC PROPERTY & DARCY-FORCHHEIMER POROUS SKIN SOLVER
 Physics Formulation:
   - Sutherland's Law for dynamic viscosity mu(T_w) of high-temperature boundary layer air.
   - Equation of state for air density rho_w at the micro-perforated skin interface.
   - Deterministic 4-iteration Newton-Raphson solver for normal suction velocity v_w.
   - Non-dimensional suction coefficient C_q calculation and drag reduction estimate.
   - Permeability tracking for micro-hole clogging diagnosis.
========================================================================================================================
*)
(* 1. Sutherland's Law dynamic viscosity calculation based on mid-wing skin temperature *)
IF rSkinTemp_Mid_K > 50.0 THEN
    rAirDynamicVisc_Pals := rSutherland_Mu0 *
                            EXPT((rSkinTemp_Mid_K / rSutherland_T0), 1.5) *
                            ((rSutherland_T0 + rSutherland_S) / (rSkinTemp_Mid_K + rSutherland_S));
ELSE
    rAirDynamicVisc_Pals := 1.716e-5;
END_IF;

(* 2. Local air density calculation at porous wall interface *)
IF (rAlt_StaticPress_mbar > 0.1) AND (rSkinTemp_Mid_K > 50.0) THEN
    (* Static pressure in Pa = mbar * 100.0 *)
    rLocalAirDensity_kgpm3 := (rAlt_StaticPress_mbar * 100.0) / (rGasConstant_Air * rSkinTemp_Mid_K);
ELSE
    rLocalAirDensity_kgpm3 := 0.055; (* Nominal stratospheric cruise density *)
END_IF;

(* 3. Online Newton-Raphson Solver for Normal Suction Velocity v_w *)
(* Governing quadratic: (beta_F * rho_w) * v_w^2 + (mu / kappa_D) * v_w - (DeltaP / t_skin) = 0 *)
IF (rVoted_DeltaP_Skin_mbar > 0.01) AND (rSkinThickness_m > 0.0001) THEN
    (* Initial linear Darcy estimate: v_w0 = (DeltaP / t_skin) * (kappa_D / mu) *)
    rNR_v_w := (rVoted_DeltaP_Skin_mbar * 100.0 / rSkinThickness_m) * (rDarcyPermeability_m2 / rAirDynamicVisc_Pals);
    
    (* Fixed 4-iteration deterministic unrolled Newton-Raphson loop *)
    FOR iNR_Iter := 1 TO 4 DO
        rNR_f_val := (rForchheimerBeta_per_m * rLocalAirDensity_kgpm3 * rNR_v_w * rNR_v_w) +
                     ((rAirDynamicVisc_Pals / rDarcyPermeability_m2) * rNR_v_w) -
                     (rVoted_DeltaP_Skin_mbar * 100.0 / rSkinThickness_m);
                     
        rNR_f_deriv := (2.0 * rForchheimerBeta_per_m * rLocalAirDensity_kgpm3 * rNR_v_w) +
                       (rAirDynamicVisc_Pals / rDarcyPermeability_m2);
                       
        IF ABS(rNR_f_deriv) > 1.0e-6 THEN
            rNR_delta_vw := rNR_f_val / rNR_f_deriv;
            rNR_v_w := rNR_v_w - rNR_delta_vw;
            IF rNR_v_w < 0.0 THEN rNR_v_w := 0.0; END_IF;
        END_IF;
    END_FOR;
    
    rSkinSuctionVelocity_mps := rNR_v_w;
ELSE
    rSkinSuctionVelocity_mps := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* 4. Suction Coefficient C_q Calculation *)
(* C_q = (rho_w * v_w) / (rho_inf * U_inf) *)
IF (rAirspeed_True_mps > 10.0) AND (rDynPress_Freestream_kPa > 0.5) THEN
    (* Freestream rho_inf = 2.0 * q_inf / U_inf^2 *)
    rSuctionCoeff_Cq := (rLocalAirDensity_kgpm3 * rSkinSuctionVelocity_mps) /
                        ((2000.0 * rDynPress_Freestream_kPa / (rAirspeed_True_mps * rAirspeed_True_mps)) * rAirspeed_True_mps);
ELSE
    rSuctionCoeff_Cq := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* 5. Aerodynamic Frictional Drag Reduction Estimate *)
(* Power savings = 0.5 * rho_inf * U_inf^3 * S_wetted * Delta_Cf *)
IF (rVoted_Mach >= 4.5) AND (rSuctionCoeff_Cq >= 0.0003) THEN
    (* Laminar boundary layer held: Delta_Cf ~ 0.00185 *)
    rEstimatedDragReduction_kW := 0.5 * (2000.0 * rDynPress_Freestream_kPa / (rAirspeed_True_mps * rAirspeed_True_mps)) *
                                  (rAirspeed_True_mps * rAirspeed_True_mps * rAirspeed_True_mps) *
                                  185.0 * 0.00185 * 0.001; (* Wing area S_w = 185 m^2 *)
    bLaminarHoldAchieved := TRUE;
ELSE
    rEstimatedDragReduction_kW := 0.0;
    bLaminarHoldAchieved := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* 6. Titanium Skin Micro-Hole Clogging / Health Filter *)
(* Compare apparent permeability kappa_est against nominal *)
IF (rSkinSuctionVelocity_mps > 0.05) AND (rVoted_DeltaP_Skin_mbar > 5.0) THEN
    rEstimatedPermeability_m2 := (rAirDynamicVisc_Pals * rSkinSuctionVelocity_mps * rSkinThickness_m) /
                                 (rVoted_DeltaP_Skin_mbar * 100.0);
    rPorousHealthFilterAcc := (rPorousHealthFilterAcc * 0.995) +
                              ((rEstimatedPermeability_m2 / rNominalPermeability_m2) * 100.0 * 0.005);
    IF rPorousHealthFilterAcc > 100.0 THEN rPorousHealthFilterAcc := 100.0; END_IF;
    IF rPorousHealthFilterAcc < 0.0 THEN rPorousHealthFilterAcc := 0.0; END_IF;
END_IF;
rSkinPorosityHealth_pct := rPorousHealthFilterAcc;

IF rSkinPorosityHealth_pct < 65.0 THEN
    wAlarmWord_Warning.1 := TRUE; (* Micro-perforated skin clogging warning *)
ELSE
    wAlarmWord_Warning.1 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(*
========================================================================================================================
 SECTION 4: SHOCK-WAVE BOUNDARY LAYER INTERACTION (SWBLI) UNSTEADINESS ANALYSIS
 Physics & Signal Processing:
   - Discrete 2nd-order bandpass filter centered around low-frequency shock unsteadiness (50 Hz - 500 Hz).
   - Real-time statistical variance accumulator for fluctuating pressure RMS.
   - Free Interaction Theory (Chapman) calculation of critical separation pressure plateau.
   - Dynamic separation margin evaluation and high-frequency piezo slit modulation.
========================================================================================================================
*)
(* 1. Direct Form II Discrete Biquad Bandpass Filter *)
rBQ_w1 := rVoted_SWBLI_RMS_kPa - (rBQ_a1 * rBQ_w2) - (rBQ_a2 * rBQ_w1);
rSWBLI_FiltSample := (rBQ_b0 * rBQ_w1) + (rBQ_b1 * rBQ_w2) + (rBQ_b2 * rBQ_w1);
rBQ_w2 := rBQ_w1;

(* 2. Moving RMS Filter Accumulation *)
rSWBLI_VarianceAcc := (rSWBLI_VarianceAcc * 0.985) + (rSWBLI_FiltSample * rSWBLI_FiltSample * 0.015);
IF rSWBLI_VarianceAcc > 0.0001 THEN
    rSWBLI_RMS_Calc := SQRT(rSWBLI_VarianceAcc);
ELSE
    rSWBLI_RMS_Calc := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* 3. Chapman Free-Interaction Critical Plateau Pressure *)
(* P_plateau = P_inf * (1 + 1.2 * (M^2 - 1)^(-0.25) * sqrt(Cf0) * 0.5 * gamma * M^2) *)
IF rVoted_Mach > 1.2 THEN
    rSWBLI_CriticalPlateau_kPa := (rAlt_StaticPress_mbar * 0.1) *
                                  (1.0 + (1.2 * EXPT((rVoted_Mach * rVoted_Mach - 1.0), -0.25) * 0.038 * 0.7 * rVoted_Mach * rVoted_Mach));
ELSE
    rSWBLI_CriticalPlateau_kPa := 25.0;
END_IF;

(* 4. SWBLI Separation Margin Calculation *)
IF rSWBLI_CriticalPlateau_kPa > 0.5 THEN
    rSWBLI_SeparationMargin_pct := ((rSWBLI_CriticalPlateau_kPa - rVoted_SWBLI_RMS_kPa) / rSWBLI_CriticalPlateau_kPa) * 100.0;
    IF rSWBLI_SeparationMargin_pct > 100.0 THEN rSWBLI_SeparationMargin_pct := 100.0; END_IF;
    IF rSWBLI_SeparationMargin_pct < 0.0 THEN rSWBLI_SeparationMargin_pct := 0.0; END_IF;
ELSE
    rSWBLI_SeparationMargin_pct := 100.0;
END_IF;

(* 5. Shock Separation Detection & Alarm Generation *)
IF rSWBLI_SeparationMargin_pct < 15.0 THEN
    wAlarmWord_Warning.2 := TRUE; (* Incipient Shock Boundary Layer Separation *)
ELSE
    wAlarmWord_Warning.2 := FALSE;
END_IF;

IF rSWBLI_SeparationMargin_pct < 5.0 THEN
    wAlarmWord_Critical.5 := TRUE; (* Severe SWBLI Separation Bubble Bursting *)
ELSE
    wAlarmWord_Critical.5 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(*
========================================================================================================================
 SECTION 5: DISTRIBUTED TURBOCOMPRESSOR AERODYNAMICS & ANTI-SURGE CONTROLLER
 Turbomachinery Mechanics:
   - Dynamic Pressure Ratio PR = P_discharge / P_suction.
   - Temperature/Pressure corrected mass flow and spool speed.
   - Parabolic surge line computation and dynamic surge margin SM [%].
   - Feedforward anti-surge blow-off valve activation.
========================================================================================================================
*)
(* 1. Pressure Ratio across suction compressor *)
IF (rAlt_StaticPress_mbar > 0.5) AND (rVoted_DeltaP_Skin_mbar > 0.0) THEN
    (* Siphon plenum pressure = Ambient - DeltaP *)
    rPR_Actual := (rAlt_StaticPress_mbar * 1.85) / MAX(0.5, (rAlt_StaticPress_mbar - rVoted_DeltaP_Skin_mbar));
    IF rPR_Actual < 1.0 THEN rPR_Actual := 1.0; END_IF;
ELSE
    rPR_Actual := 1.0;
END_IF;

(* 2. Corrected Mass Flow *)
IF (rCompressorMassFlow_kgps > 0.0) AND (rSkinTemp_Mid_K > 100.0) THEN
    rW_Corrected_kgps := rCompressorMassFlow_kgps * SQRT(rSkinTemp_Mid_K / 288.15) /
                         MAX(0.01, (rAlt_StaticPress_mbar / 1013.25));
ELSE
    rW_Corrected_kgps := 0.01;
END_IF;

(* 3. Parabolic Surge Line Evaluation: PR_surge = c0 + c1 * W + c2 * W^2 *)
rPR_SurgeLine := rSurgeLine_Coeff0 +
                 (rSurgeLine_Coeff1 * rW_Corrected_kgps) +
                 (rSurgeLine_Coeff2 * rW_Corrected_kgps * rW_Corrected_kgps);

IF rPR_SurgeLine < 1.05 THEN rPR_SurgeLine := 1.05; END_IF;

(* 4. Active Surge Margin Percentage *)
IF rPR_SurgeLine > 0.1 THEN
    rSurgeMargin_Calc := ((rPR_SurgeLine - rPR_Actual) / rPR_SurgeLine) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rSurgeMargin_Calc := 50.0;
END_IF;
rCompressorSurgeMargin_pct := rSurgeMargin_Calc;

(* 5. Surge Warning and Interlock Bits *)
IF rCompressorSurgeMargin_pct < rSurgeMargin_WarnThresh THEN
    wAlarmWord_Warning.3 := TRUE; (* Compressor Surge Margin Low Warning *)
ELSE
    wAlarmWord_Warning.3 := FALSE;
END_IF;

IF rCompressorSurgeMargin_pct < rSurgeMargin_TripThresh THEN
    wAlarmWord_Critical.6 := TRUE; (* Turbocompressor Imminent Surge Trip *)
ELSE
    wAlarmWord_Critical.6 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(*
========================================================================================================================
 SECTION 6: MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) QUADRATIC COST OPTIMIZATION
 Embedded Solver Architecture:
   - Plant State Estimation via discrete observer: x(k+1) = A*x(k) + B*u(k).
   - Output Prediction: y(k) = C*x(k) + D*u(k).
   - Tracking Error: e(k) = Setpoint - y(k).
   - Unrolled Projected Gradient Descent (6 Iterations) on quadratic performance index:
       J = Delta_u^T * H * Delta_u + 2 * g^T * Delta_u
       where g = -K_LQR * e(k).
   - Box constraints enforcing actuator position and slew rate clamping.
========================================================================================================================
*)
(* 1. Formulate dynamic setpoints based on flight Mach regime *)
IF rVoted_Mach >= 5.0 THEN
    aSetpointR[1] := 8.5;  (* Target C_q * 1e4 *)
    aSetpointR[2] := 55.0; (* Target DeltaP skin [mbar] *)
    aSetpointR[3] := 1.5;  (* Target SWBLI RMS [kPa] *)
    aSetpointR[4] := 22.0; (* Target Surge Margin [%] *)
ELSIF rVoted_Mach >= 1.5 THEN
    aSetpointR[1] := 5.0;
    aSetpointR[2] := 32.0;
    aSetpointR[3] := 2.5;
    aSetpointR[4] := 20.0;
ELSE
    aSetpointR[1] := 1.5;
    aSetpointR[2] := 10.0;
    aSetpointR[3] := 3.5;
    aSetpointR[4] := 18.0;
END_IF;

(* 2. Map plant outputs into measurement vector y *)
aOutputY[1] := rSuctionCoeff_Cq * 10000.0;
aOutputY[2] := rVoted_DeltaP_Skin_mbar;
aOutputY[3] := rVoted_SWBLI_RMS_kPa;
aOutputY[4] := rCompressorSurgeMargin_pct;

(* 3. Compute State Observation & Error: e = C*x - y *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 4 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 6 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (aC[iRow, iCol] * aStateX[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    aStateError[iRow] := aSetpointR[iRow] - (rTempSum + aOutputY[iRow] * 0.1);
END_FOR;
aStateError[5] := -rVoted_SWBLI_RMS_kPa * 0.2;
aStateError[6] := (rVoted_SpoolSpeed_rpm - 65000.0) * 0.0001;

(* 4. Compute Linear Gradient Vector: g = -K_LQR * e *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 4 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 6 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum - (aK_LQR[iRow, iCol] * aStateError[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    aGradG[iRow] := rTempSum;
END_FOR;

(* 5. Initialize Optimization Variables *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 4 DO
    aDeltaU[iRow] := 0.0;
END_FOR;

(* 6. Unrolled Projected Gradient Descent (6 Fixed Deterministic Iterations) *)
FOR iIterQP := 1 TO 6 DO
    FOR iRow := 1 TO 4 DO
        (* Compute matrix-vector product: (Hessian * DeltaU)[iRow] *)
        rTempSum := 0.0;
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
            rTempSum := rTempSum + (aHessian[iRow, iCol] * aDeltaU[iCol]);
        END_FOR;
        
        (* Gradient step: DeltaU := DeltaU - alpha * (H*DeltaU + g) *)
        rProjVal := aDeltaU[iRow] - (rStepAlpha * (rTempSum + aGradG[iRow]));
        
        (* Project onto slew rate box constraints [Delta_u_min, Delta_u_max] *)
        IF iRow = 1 THEN
            (* Turbocompressor Spool Speed Trim [rpm] *)
            IF rProjVal > (rSpool_RateMax_rpmps * rScanDeltaTime_Sec) THEN
                rProjVal := rSpool_RateMax_rpmps * rScanDeltaTime_Sec;
            ELSIF rProjVal < (-rSpool_RateMax_rpmps * rScanDeltaTime_Sec) THEN
                rProjVal := -rSpool_RateMax_rpmps * rScanDeltaTime_Sec;
            END_IF;
        ELSIF iRow = 2 THEN
            (* VIGV Angle Trim [deg] *)
            IF rProjVal > (rVIGV_RateMax_degps * rScanDeltaTime_Sec) THEN
                rProjVal := rVIGV_RateMax_degps * rScanDeltaTime_Sec;
            ELSIF rProjVal < (-rVIGV_RateMax_degps * rScanDeltaTime_Sec) THEN
                rProjVal := -rVIGV_RateMax_degps * rScanDeltaTime_Sec;
            END_IF;
        ELSIF iRow = 3 THEN
            (* Bypass Valve Trim [deg] *)
            IF rProjVal > (rBypass_RateMax_degps * rScanDeltaTime_Sec) THEN
                rProjVal := rBypass_RateMax_degps * rScanDeltaTime_Sec;
            ELSIF rProjVal < (-rBypass_RateMax_degps * rScanDeltaTime_Sec) THEN
                rProjVal := -rBypass_RateMax_degps * rScanDeltaTime_Sec;
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            (* SWBLI Piezo Micro-Slit Trim [%] *)
            IF rProjVal > (rSWBLI_Slit_RateMax_pctps * rScanDeltaTime_Sec) THEN
                rProjVal := rSWBLI_Slit_RateMax_pctps * rScanDeltaTime_Sec;
            ELSIF rProjVal < (-rSWBLI_Slit_RateMax_pctps * rScanDeltaTime_Sec) THEN
                rProjVal := -rSWBLI_Slit_RateMax_pctps * rScanDeltaTime_Sec;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;
        
        aDeltaU[iRow] := rProjVal;
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;

(* 7. Update Control Actuation Vector *)
aControlU[1] := aControlU_Prev[1] + aDeltaU[1];
aControlU[2] := aControlU_Prev[2] + aDeltaU[2];
aControlU[3] := aControlU_Prev[3] + aDeltaU[3];
aControlU[4] := aControlU_Prev[4] + aDeltaU[4];

(* Actuator Absolute Physical Clamping *)
IF aControlU[1] < rSpool_Min_rpm THEN aControlU[1] := rSpool_Min_rpm; END_IF;
IF aControlU[1] > rSpool_Max_rpm THEN aControlU[1] := rSpool_Max_rpm; END_IF;

IF aControlU[2] < rVIGV_Min_deg THEN aControlU[2] := rVIGV_Min_deg; END_IF;
IF aControlU[2] > rVIGV_Max_deg THEN aControlU[2] := rVIGV_Max_deg; END_IF;

IF aControlU[3] < rBypass_Min_deg THEN aControlU[3] := rBypass_Min_deg; END_IF;
IF aControlU[3] > rBypass_Max_deg THEN aControlU[3] := rBypass_Max_deg; END_IF;

IF aControlU[4] < rSWBLI_Slit_Min_pct THEN aControlU[4] := rSWBLI_Slit_Min_pct; END_IF;
IF aControlU[4] > rSWBLI_Slit_Max_pct THEN aControlU[4] := rSWBLI_Slit_Max_pct; END_IF;

aControlU_Prev[1] := aControlU[1];
aControlU_Prev[2] := aControlU[2];
aControlU_Prev[3] := aControlU[3];
aControlU_Prev[4] := aControlU[4];

(* 8. Update Discrete State Propagation for Next Scan: x(k+1) = A*x(k) + B*DeltaU *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 6 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (aA[iRow, iCol] * aStateX[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (aB[iRow, iCol] * aDeltaU[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    aStateX_Next[iRow] := rTempSum;
END_FOR;

FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
    aStateX[iRow] := aStateX_Next[iRow];
END_FOR;

(*
========================================================================================================================
 SECTION 7: TITANIUM AUTO-IGNITION & THERMAL RUNAWAY INTERLOCK
 Hazard Mechanism:
   - High-temperature aerodynamic boundary layer friction heating of titanium wing skin.
   - At temperatures above 1150 K, high-pressure oxygen flow through micro-perforations presents severe titanium
     oxidation and auto-ignition fire hazard.
   - Mitigation: Online fire hazard index monitoring, immediate high-speed nitrogen inerting gas deluge,
     and pneumatic plenum suction isolation.
========================================================================================================================
*)
(* 1. Compute Peak Titanium Wing Skin Temperature *)
rTempSum := MAX(rSkinTemp_Fore_K, MAX(rSkinTemp_Mid_K, rSkinTemp_Aft_K));

(* 2. Online Fire Hazard Metric J_fire = (T_peak - T_warn) * DeltaP * Mach *)
IF rTempSum > rTitaniumWarningTemp_K THEN
    rFireHazardIndex := (rTempSum - rTitaniumWarningTemp_K) * (rVoted_DeltaP_Skin_mbar / 50.0) * (rVoted_Mach / 5.0);
    wAlarmWord_Warning.4 := TRUE; (* Titanium High Skin Temperature Advisory *)
ELSE
    rFireHazardIndex := 0.0;
    wAlarmWord_Warning.4 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* 3. Auto-Ignition Emergency Safety Trip *)
IF (rTempSum >= rTitaniumIgnitionCritTemp_K) OR
   (rVoted_DeltaP_Skin_mbar >= rDeltaP_FireHazardLimit_mbar AND rTempSum > 980.0) OR
   (rFireHazardIndex > 150.0) THEN
    bAutoIgnitionTripLatched := TRUE;
    bTitaniumFireRiskTrip := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord_Critical.7 := TRUE; (* Titanium Fire Auto-Ignition Emergency Trip *)
    iStateStep := 80;              (* Transition to Titanium Thermal Purge *)
END_IF;

IF bDeiceHeatingInhibit AND (rTempSum > 800.0) THEN
    wAlarmWord_Warning.5 := TRUE; (* Thermal Anti-Ice Conflict Warning *)
ELSE
    wAlarmWord_Warning.5 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(*
========================================================================================================================
 SECTION 8: MULTI-TIER ALARM HIERARCHY & SAFETY FAULT ENGINE
 Diagnostic Architecture:
   - Evaluates system health bitmasks.
   - Manages graceful degradation triggers and flight control status words.
========================================================================================================================
*)
(* APU / Electric Bus Power Undervoltage Check *)
IF rAPU_ShaftPower_kW < 35.0 THEN
    wAlarmWord_Warning.6 := TRUE; (* Low APU Shaft Power Delivery *)
ELSE
    wAlarmWord_Warning.6 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Bleed Valve Angle Deviation Check *)
IF ABS(rBleedValveAngle_deg - aControlU[3]) > 12.0 THEN
    wAlarmWord_Warning.7 := TRUE; (* Bypass Valve Actuator Tracking Error *)
ELSE
    wAlarmWord_Warning.7 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Evaluate Critical Trip Latching *)
IF (wAlarmWord_Critical <> 16#0000) AND (iStateStep < 80) THEN
    IF bAutoIgnitionTripLatched THEN
        iStateStep := 80; (* Prioritize Thermal Fire Purge *)
    ELSE
        iStateStep := 90; (* Emergency Vent Lockout *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(*
========================================================================================================================
 SECTION 9: 10-STAGE DETERMINISTIC FINITE STATE MACHINE (CASE iStateStep OF ... END_CASE;)
 State Sequences:
   0:  STATE_COLD_INIT_BITE           - Power-On Built-In Test & Sensor TMR Calibration
   10: STATE_SUBSONIC_STANDBY         - Low-speed cruise / climb (Mach < 0.8), purge active
   20: STATE_TRANSONIC_PRE_SUCTION    - Transonic acceleration (Mach 0.8 - 1.5), compressor spin-up
   30: STATE_SUPERSONIC_ACCEL         - Supersonic climb (Mach 1.5 - 4.5), transition delay suction
   40: STATE_HYPERSONIC_CRUISE_MPC    - Hypersonic cruise (Mach 4.5 - 8.5), full multi-plenum MPC
   50: STATE_SWBLI_ACTIVE_SUPPRESSION - High-rate SWBLI micro-suction slit modulation
   60: STATE_COMPRESSOR_SURGE_ESCAPE  - Rapid bypass blow-off & VIGV transient surge recovery
   70: STATE_DEGRADED_FAILOVER        - Single channel sensor failure / reduced suction profile
   80: STATE_TITANIUM_THERMAL_PURGE   - Thermal runaway / N2 inert purge fire suppression
   90: STATE_EMERGENCY_VENT_LOCKOUT   - Safety bus trip / fail-safe pneumatic bypass lockout
========================================================================================================================
*)
CASE iStateStep OF

    0: (* STATE_COLD_INIT_BITE *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bLaminarHoldAchieved := FALSE;
        bEmergencyVentActive := FALSE;
        
        (* Actuator Safe Defaults *)
        rSuctionMassFlowCmd_kgps := 0.0;
        rVIGV_AngleCmd_deg := 0.0;
        rSpoolSpeedCmd_rpm := rSpool_Min_rpm;
        rBypassValveCmd_deg := 30.0;
        rPlenumPressTarget_mbar := rAlt_StaticPress_mbar;
        rSWBLI_SlitAperture_pct := 0.0;
        
        tonBITE_Timer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#3S);
        IF tonBITE_Timer.Q THEN
            tonBITE_Timer(IN := FALSE);
            IF bMasterEnable AND bEmergencyStop AND (wAlarmWord_Critical = 16#0000) THEN
                iStateStep := 10;
                rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE_SUBSONIC_STANDBY *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bLaminarHoldAchieved := FALSE;
        bEmergencyVentActive := FALSE;
        
        (* Keep suction low to avoid particulate and moisture ingestion *)
        rSuctionMassFlowCmd_kgps := 0.05;
        rVIGV_AngleCmd_deg := -5.0;
        rSpoolSpeedCmd_rpm := 22000.0;
        rBypassValveCmd_deg := 45.0;
        rPlenumPressTarget_mbar := rAlt_StaticPress_mbar * 0.98;
        rSWBLI_SlitAperture_pct := 0.0;
        
        IF rVoted_Mach >= 0.8 THEN
            iStateStep := 20;
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        ELSIF NOT bMasterEnable THEN
            iStateStep := 0;
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE_TRANSONIC_PRE_SUCTION *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bLaminarHoldAchieved := FALSE;
        bEmergencyVentActive := FALSE;
        
        (* Pre-evacuate plenums and spin turbocompressors into operating band *)
        rSuctionMassFlowCmd_kgps := 0.45;
        rVIGV_AngleCmd_deg := 5.0;
        rSpoolSpeedCmd_rpm := 48000.0;
        rBypassValveCmd_deg := 25.0;
        rPlenumPressTarget_mbar := rAlt_StaticPress_mbar * 0.85;
        rSWBLI_SlitAperture_pct := 5.0;
        
        IF rVoted_Mach >= 1.5 THEN
            iStateStep := 30;
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        ELSIF rVoted_Mach < 0.75 THEN
            iStateStep := 10;
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE_SUPERSONIC_ACCEL *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bLaminarHoldAchieved := FALSE;
        bEmergencyVentActive := FALSE;
        
        (* Mid-level suction for transition delay *)
        rSuctionMassFlowCmd_kgps := 1.25;
        rVIGV_AngleCmd_deg := 15.0;
        rSpoolSpeedCmd_rpm := 68000.0;
        rBypassValveCmd_deg := 12.0;
        rPlenumPressTarget_mbar := rAlt_StaticPress_mbar * 0.65;
        rSWBLI_SlitAperture_pct := 15.0;
        
        IF rCompressorSurgeMargin_pct < rSurgeMargin_TripThresh THEN
            iStateStep := 60; (* Surge recovery *)
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        ELSIF rVoted_Mach >= 4.5 THEN
            iStateStep := 40; (* Hypersonic cruise MPC *)
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        ELSIF rVoted_Mach < 1.35 THEN
            iStateStep := 20;
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE_HYPERSONIC_CRUISE_MPC *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bEmergencyVentActive := FALSE;
        
        (* Execute MPC Optimization Commands *)
        rSpoolSpeedCmd_rpm := aControlU[1];
        rVIGV_AngleCmd_deg := aControlU[2];
        rBypassValveCmd_deg := aControlU[3];
        rSWBLI_SlitAperture_pct := aControlU[4];
        
        rSuctionMassFlowCmd_kgps := 2.85 * (rVoted_Mach / 6.0) * (rDynPress_Freestream_kPa / 45.0);
        rPlenumPressTarget_mbar := rAlt_StaticPress_mbar - aSetpointR[2];
        
        (* Evaluate SWBLI and Surge Condition Triggers *)
        IF (rSWBLI_SeparationMargin_pct < 15.0) OR (rVoted_SWBLI_RMS_kPa > 3.5) THEN
            iStateStep := 50; (* High-rate SWBLI suppression *)
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        ELSIF rCompressorSurgeMargin_pct < rSurgeMargin_TripThresh THEN
            iStateStep := 60; (* Compressor Surge Escape *)
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        ELSIF bDegradedOperation THEN
            iStateStep := 70; (* Degraded Failover Mode *)
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        ELSIF rVoted_Mach < 4.2 THEN
            iStateStep := 30; (* Deceleration back to supersonic *)
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE_SWBLI_ACTIVE_SUPPRESSION *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bEmergencyVentActive := FALSE;
        
        (* Force Maximum Micro-Slit Suction and Ramp Turbocompressor Vacuum *)
        rSWBLI_SlitAperture_pct := 85.0 + (15.0 * (1.0 - (rSWBLI_SeparationMargin_pct / 15.0)));
        IF rSWBLI_SlitAperture_pct > 100.0 THEN rSWBLI_SlitAperture_pct := 100.0; END_IF;
        
        rSpoolSpeedCmd_rpm := aControlU[1] + 6500.0;
        IF rSpoolSpeedCmd_rpm > rSpool_Max_rpm THEN rSpoolSpeedCmd_rpm := rSpool_Max_rpm; END_IF;
        
        rVIGV_AngleCmd_deg := aControlU[2] + 12.0;
        rBypassValveCmd_deg := 5.0;
        rSuctionMassFlowCmd_kgps := 3.65;
        rPlenumPressTarget_mbar := rAlt_StaticPress_mbar - 65.0;
        
        (* Return to normal MPC once shock separation unsteadiness is damped *)
        IF (rSWBLI_SeparationMargin_pct >= 25.0) AND (rVoted_SWBLI_RMS_kPa < 2.0) AND (rStateTimer_Sec > 3.0) THEN
            iStateStep := 40;
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        ELSIF rCompressorSurgeMargin_pct < rSurgeMargin_TripThresh THEN
            iStateStep := 60;
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    60: (* STATE_COMPRESSOR_SURGE_ESCAPE *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bLaminarHoldAchieved := FALSE;
        bEmergencyVentActive := FALSE;
        
        (* Pop open anti-surge bypass blow-off valve to dump pressure ratio *)
        rBypassValveCmd_deg := 85.0;
        rVIGV_AngleCmd_deg := -10.0;
        rSpoolSpeedCmd_rpm := rVoted_SpoolSpeed_rpm * 0.85;
        rSWBLI_SlitAperture_pct := 10.0;
        rSuctionMassFlowCmd_kgps := 0.85;
        rPlenumPressTarget_mbar := rAlt_StaticPress_mbar;
        
        tonSurgeRecoveryTimer(IN := (rCompressorSurgeMargin_pct >= 20.0), PT := T#2S);
        IF tonSurgeRecoveryTimer.Q THEN
            tonSurgeRecoveryTimer(IN := FALSE);
            IF rVoted_Mach >= 4.5 THEN
                iStateStep := 40; (* Re-engage hypersonic cruise *)
            ELSE
                iStateStep := 30;
            END_IF;
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    70: (* STATE_DEGRADED_FAILOVER *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bLaminarHoldAchieved := FALSE;
        bEmergencyVentActive := FALSE;
        
        (* Conservative suction schedule using bounded open-loop lookup *)
        rSpoolSpeedCmd_rpm := 55000.0;
        rVIGV_AngleCmd_deg := 10.0;
        rBypassValveCmd_deg := 20.0;
        rSWBLI_SlitAperture_pct := 25.0;
        rSuctionMassFlowCmd_kgps := 1.65;
        rPlenumPressTarget_mbar := rAlt_StaticPress_mbar - 28.0;
        
        IF NOT bDegradedOperation THEN
            iStateStep := 40; (* Sensor health restored *)
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        ELSIF rVoted_Mach < 4.0 THEN
            iStateStep := 30;
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    80: (* STATE_TITANIUM_THERMAL_PURGE *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bLaminarHoldAchieved := FALSE;
        bEmergencyVentActive := TRUE;
        
        (* Isolate suction valves, open bypass dump, and inject N2 inert purge *)
        rSpoolSpeedCmd_rpm := rSpool_Min_rpm;
        rVIGV_AngleCmd_deg := -12.0;
        rBypassValveCmd_deg := 90.0;
        rSWBLI_SlitAperture_pct := 0.0;
        rSuctionMassFlowCmd_kgps := 0.0;
        rPlenumPressTarget_mbar := rAlt_StaticPress_mbar + 10.0; (* Overpressure purge *)
        
        tonPurgeDwellTimer(IN := bInertGasPurgeActive, PT := T#15S);
        IF tonPurgeDwellTimer.Q AND (rTempSum < 850.0) AND NOT bAutoIgnitionTripLatched THEN
            tonPurgeDwellTimer(IN := FALSE);
            bTitaniumFireRiskTrip := FALSE;
            iStateStep := 10; (* Return to subsonic/standby purge *)
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    90: (* STATE_EMERGENCY_VENT_LOCKOUT *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bLaminarHoldAchieved := FALSE;
        bEmergencyVentActive := TRUE;
        
        (* Fail-Safe Hard Lockout: De-energize all vacuum systems, vent plenums *)
        rSuctionMassFlowCmd_kgps := 0.0;
        rSpoolSpeedCmd_rpm := 0.0;
        rVIGV_AngleCmd_deg := 0.0;
        rBypassValveCmd_deg := 90.0;
        rSWBLI_SlitAperture_pct := 0.0;
        rPlenumPressTarget_mbar := rAlt_StaticPress_mbar;
        
        IF bEmergencyStop AND bResetLatchedFaults AND (wAlarmWord_Critical = 16#0000) THEN
            iStateStep := 0; (* Return to Cold BITE *)
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    ELSE
        iStateStep := 90; (* Catch-all safe fail state *)
END_CASE;

(*
========================================================================================================================
 SECTION 10: ACTUATOR OUTPUT SLEW RATE LIMITING & SATURATION CLAMPING
 DO-178C Level A Output Assurance:
   - Clamps all commanded outputs to physical mechanical limits.
   - Updates packed system status word for flight management avionics.
========================================================================================================================
*)
(* 1. Command Clamping *)
IF rSpoolSpeedCmd_rpm < 0.0 THEN rSpoolSpeedCmd_rpm := 0.0; END_IF;
IF rSpoolSpeedCmd_rpm > rSpool_Max_rpm THEN rSpoolSpeedCmd_rpm := rSpool_Max_rpm; END_IF;

IF rVIGV_AngleCmd_deg < rVIGV_Min_deg THEN rVIGV_AngleCmd_deg := rVIGV_Min_deg; END_IF;
IF rVIGV_AngleCmd_deg > rVIGV_Max_deg THEN rVIGV_AngleCmd_deg := rVIGV_Max_deg; END_IF;

IF rBypassValveCmd_deg < 0.0 THEN rBypassValveCmd_deg := 0.0; END_IF;
IF rBypassValveCmd_deg > 90.0 THEN rBypassValveCmd_deg := 90.0; END_IF;

IF rSWBLI_SlitAperture_pct < 0.0 THEN rSWBLI_SlitAperture_pct := 0.0; END_IF;
IF rSWBLI_SlitAperture_pct > 100.0 THEN rSWBLI_SlitAperture_pct := 100.0; END_IF;

IF rSuctionMassFlowCmd_kgps < 0.0 THEN rSuctionMassFlowCmd_kgps := 0.0; END_IF;
IF rSuctionMassFlowCmd_kgps > 8.0 THEN rSuctionMassFlowCmd_kgps := 8.0; END_IF;

(* 2. Pack ARINC-429 / AFDX System Status Word *)
wSystemStatusWord.0 := bSystemReady;
wSystemStatusWord.1 := bLaminarHoldAchieved;
wSystemStatusWord.2 := bDegradedOperation;
wSystemStatusWord.3 := bTitaniumFireRiskTrip;
wSystemStatusWord.4 := bEmergencyVentActive;
wSystemStatusWord.5 := (iStateStep = 40); (* Cruising under MPC *)
wSystemStatusWord.6 := (iStateStep = 50); (* SWBLI Active Suppression *)
wSystemStatusWord.7 := (iStateStep = 60); (* Surge Escape Active *)
wSystemStatusWord.8 := (iStateStep = 80); (* Fire Thermal Purge Active *)
wSystemStatusWord.9 := (iStateStep = 90); (* Emergency Vent Lockout *)

iPreviousState := iStateStep;

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
